1.name: Dawnstar's Flowing Trail
1.desc: Increases CRIT DMG by <color=#99FFFFFF>24%</color>. The equipping character gains the Crystal Compounding effect when they use their Elemental Skill, increasing Elemental Mastery by <color=#99FFFFFF>48</color> for 20s. During this time, the equipping character gains a stack of Law of Combustion when a nearby party member triggers an Elemental Reaction. Each stack increases Elemental Mastery by an additional <color=#99FFFFFF>24</color>. Max 3 stacks. These stacks last until Crystal Compounding ends or the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill again.\n<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: Each Law of Combustion stack also increases the equipping character's Stellar-Conduct CRIT DMG by <color=#99FFFFFF>12%</color>.
